partial final blocks mean positions past the sequence end belong to the next sequence and must not contribute to the softmax (key domain per query is exact).", "block_mask is per (query-head, query-block, key-block); GQA (nhead_q multiple of nhead_k) is permitted by the wrapper's assertion.", "Softmax normalization must use only in-scope keys; rows whose selected-key set is empty would need defined behavior (contract does not state what, e.g. zeros)."], "kernel_model": ["Triton kernel _fwd_kernel does online-softmax flash attention over variable-sized q/k blocks via precomputed cu_q_block / cu_k_block / q_block_to_batch / cu_num_k_block index tensors built by calculate_blocks().", "calculate_blocks: per-batch block counts ceil-div block_size, cu_block gives flat start offsets of each block, block_sizes handles last partial block per batch, block_to_batch maps block index to batch; grid is (num_q_block, nhead_q).", "Per (q_block, head): loads q rows masked by off_m < end_m (last partial q block), loops over the same batch's k blocks, skips blocks where block_mask is False; causal gate uses end_m/start_n with a per-batch offset.", "Masks: q/k/v loads masked by off_n < end_n for partial k blocks; after computing qk, applies -inf via tl.where for causal (per-row condition) and for partial k blocks (line 155-156) before exp; online softmax accumulates m_i, l_i, acc, and rescales at the end (l_i==0 -> 1 fallback for empty rows).", "GQA handled by off_head_k = off_head_q // head_q_to_k_ratio; block_mask indexed by off_head_k (one mask row per k-head shared by its q-heads).", "Wrapper _forward_fix_tile_size computes EVEN_SEQ_QBLOCK/EVEN_SEQ_KBLOCK/EVEN_HEADDIM constexprs, BLOCK_DIM = next_power_of_2(headdim) min 16, and launches with strides; returns out (lse/tmp allocated but tmp unused; lse stored but not returned).", "allow_tf32=False on both tl.dot calls; qk computed in fp32, p cast to v's dtype before second dot."], "open_questions": ["What does the reference implementation do for query rows with no selected/unmasked key block — divide by zero, NaN, or zeros? The kernel's l_i==0->1 fallback gives zeros; is that the contract?", "Does the harness test causal=True, GQA (nhead_q != nhead_k), uneven block sizes, headdim not a power of two, or fp16 vs fp32 inputs?", "Is block_mask guaranteed shape (nhead_k, num_q_block, num_k_block) with contiguous layout, matching the kernel's stride-based indexing with off_head_k?", "Does the reference use exactly softmax(qk/sqrt(d)) with no other scaling, matching softmax_scale default headdim**-0.5?"], "risk_map": ["Causal alignment arithmetic: line 112 and 153 use 'end_m - batch_q_start_idx + offset' and 'off_m - batch_q_start_idx + offset' vs 'off_n - batch_k_start_idx'. With differing q/k sequence lengths per batch, the offset shifts the causal boundary; verify this matches the intended causal definition when seq lengths differ (cross-attention-style varlen).", "EVEN_SEQ_KBLOCK (line 226) is computed as total packed length % block_size == 0 — it ignores per-batch partial blocks. If total is a multiple of block_size but some batch's k length isn't, the k-block tail mask at line 155-156 is skipped and keys from the next sequence could leak into the softmax. This is a prime bug surface given the problem statement emphasizes partial blocks.", "The causal per-row mask (line 153) is applied AFTER m_ij subtraction but the block-skip condition (line 112) uses only end_m (block end), so a fully-masked block may still run; that's fine correctness-wise but the m_ij update from an all -inf block could be affected — check alpha/m_i behavior when a block contributes nothing.", "tl.exp on -inf masked entries gives 0 correctly, but if a partial k block is skipped via EVEN_SEQ_KBLOCK misclassification, actual out-of-sequence rows produce real scores — leakage across sequence boundaries.", "GQA mapping: off_head_k = off_head_q // head_q_to_k_ratio assumes a specific head grouping (consecutive q heads per k head); verify off-by-one at the final block."], "scope_notes": ["Scope is the forward pass only (out tensor); lse/tmp are internal.", "Problem statement explicitly stresses arbitrary non-multiple-of-block-size sequence lengths — partial-block handling is in scope and is the core contract emphasis.", "Causal flag exists in the API;
